summary: First Financial Corporation (FFC) filed an 8-K to report entry into a merger agreement with First Illinois Corporation. Under the terms, each First Illinois share will convert into either 0.5727 FFC shares or $44.35 cash, with a 70% stock/30% cash mix. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal, expected to close in Q4 2026. First Illinois will merge into FFC, with its bank subsidiary merging into First Financial Bank. Consideration may be reduced if First Illinois' adjusted equity falls below $82.4 million. Watch for regulatory approvals and stock election proration.
